maya_cs: Heads-up: Saffron private deploy tomorrow 11:00 PT. Quick checklist: egress for log-forwarder, IAM assume-role, CMK access, and audit retention. Short replies only.

kevin_net: Network: forwarder in private subnet -> NAT. Need S3 VPCE, splunk.ingest.saffron.com (203.0.113.99), and telemetry.redwood.net allowed. Recommend replace NAT route to S3 with VPCE during cutover.

kevin_net: Example SG egress: TCP 443 -> vpce-0b2c3d4e, TCP 443 -> 203.0.113.99/32, TCP 443 -> telemetry.redwood.net

hideo_kms: KMS: ask customer to create symmetric CMK and add key policy allowing arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-telemetry-decrypt with kms:Decrypt & kms:GenerateDataKey. Default rotation yearly.

anya_sec: IAM: need trust policy for sts:AssumeRole from our account id. Constrain with aws:SourceVpc when possible. For audit: customer requested 3 years; confirm if S3 Object Lock required.

maya_cs: Customer says: "Prefer tamper-evident logs for 3 years; legal hold TBD." I'll confirm cert flow for mTLS.

runbot: (automated) Reminder: Saffron cutover runbook meeting 11:00 PT. Link: https://meet.redwood/rooms/saffron-cutover

maya_cs: Action items: (1) customer to provide CMK ARN, (2) customer to create role and share ARN, (3) confirm WORM requirement, (4) provide mTLS CSR process or indicate upload. Will add to runbook before the call.

kevin_net: Also recommend prefix filtering and 1:5 sampling for first 48 hours to limit costs.

maya_cs: Thanks all
